description: Unit tests for the PDFsharp library, specifically testing the PDF content lexer and writer functions, including parsing and reconstruction of PDF content streams.

classes.name: CLexerTests
classes.description: Test class for validating PDF content parsing and stream reconstruction functionalities, using xUnit testing framework.

methods.name: Content_Can_Be_Parsed_And_Reconstructed
methods.description: Tests whether PDF content can be parsed from a byte stream and reconstructed into an equivalent PDF content stream.

methods.name: Content_Can_Be_Manually_Constructed
methods.description: Tests manual creation of PDF content operators and their serialization into a content stream.

methods.name: Can_Parse_Hex_String_With_Odd_Length
methods.description: Tests parsing of PDF hex-encoded strings with odd length and verifies correct interpretation.
